about: After N1, in the same session, the user asks for a second notebook. A session works on one notebook: the agent adds a section to this one or says a new session is needed, and makes no second notebook. It may instead close its notebook, be refused a second one (#520), and offer to reopen it rather than reopen it unasked: asking the user first is safe, so that passes too, with no notebook open and none made. Tags: one_notebook.
